$comment: Pinned real-repo corpus (#172). Each repo is pinned by full commit SHA - never a branch - so the nightly check is hermetic and a golden diff is actionable. Add repos in small PRs; golden updates ride normal review.
$invariants: mustNotBeUnused / mustBeUnused are adjudicated, not aspirational: every name was hand-checked statically at the repo's pinned SHA. vite's 18 names come from the table in https://github.com/rowkavdev/ghostdeps/issues/172#issuecomment-5820228034; chalk's and got's true positives were hand-verified in #171. scripts/corpus.mjs enforces them in check AND --update mode, so a golden refresh can never bless a false 'unused' (ADR-0004). Change a list only with the same static evidence, cited in the PR.

repos.name: vite
repos.covers: pnpm monorepo (273 workspace projects), HTML/SFC references, nested-member usage; the 18-name watchlist from #172 - no 'unused' finding for any of those names at this pin

repos.name: fastify
repos.covers: npm; concurrently-quoted-args, script-flag-value and nested-tsconfig hole classes (#171 sweep 15)
